shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; else echo 'NO_ROUND_BRIEF'; fi && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md && echo '--- test commands ---' && sed -n '1,240p' .lore/test-commands.yml"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && sed -n '1,280p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && sed -n '1,280p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && sed -n '1,320p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts && rg -n \"tool_result|processMessage|ToolResponse|execute\\(\" src/orchestration src/types | head -120 && rg -n \"validated by|specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation|spec:\" specs src/orchestration | head -120"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts && sed -n '260,620p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts && sed -n '150,300p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && sed -n '1,280p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts && cat package.json && sed -n '1,220p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,280p' src/orchestration/orchestratorHelpers.ts && git log -4 --oneline --decorate && git show --stat --oneline HEAD && git show HEAD -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '1,260p'"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts -t "feeds a schema rejection to the provider before the corrected tool call"'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'tail -120 src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts && rg -n "feeds a schema|Orchestrator tool-loop recovery|rejection returns" src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && git diff --stat && git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git diff --check && git diff --stat && git status --short'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts -t "feeds a schema rejection to the provider before the corrected tool call"'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff -- .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git commit -m "test: cover schema rejection tool loop" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main'
